description: CRIT-001 asserts '(5) charge_id persistence before subscription'. REQ-BILL-013 requires 'immediately persist members.payjp_initial_charge_id and members.initial_charge_paid_at, then create a subscription'. In subscribe.ts, after createCharge succeeds (line 166), the charge id is stored in a local variable initialChargeId (line 190), but is NOT persisted to DB until updateMemberAfterSubscribe (line 235-236). The subscription creation happens at line 212, BEFORE the charge_id is persisted. If subscription creation fails after charge succeeds, the charge_id is lost from DB (only in local variable). PROP-BILL-062 test asserts 'createCharge < createSubscription' (execution order) but does NOT assert charge_id DB persistence before subscription creation. There is no separate DB call to persist payjp_initial_charge_id immediately after charge.
